GARDENA.NAME: GARDENA smart system
GARDENA.DESCRIPTION: GARDENA smart system via the official GARDENA smart system API

APPLICATION_KEY.NAME: Application key
APPLICATION_KEY.DESCRIPTION: Application key from developer.husqvarnagroup.cloud (connected to the GARDENA smart system API)

LOCATION_ID.NAME: Location ID
LOCATION_ID.DESCRIPTION: Optional. Empty = the first location of the account

SCAN.NAME: Search devices
SCAN.DESCRIPTION: Lists the valves, mowers, power sockets and sensors of the location

STATUS.NAME: Status
STATUS.DESCRIPTION: OK or the last error (e.g. request limit reached)

SOCKET_CONNECTED.NAME: Live connection
SOCKET_CONNECTED.DESCRIPTION: True while the web socket is connected

WATERING.NAME: Watering
WATERING.DESCRIPTION: Write true to water for the default duration, false to stop until the next scheduled task

WATER_MINUTES.NAME: Water for [min]
WATER_MINUTES.DESCRIPTION: Write minutes to water that long, 0 to stop

PAUSE.NAME: Pause schedule
PAUSE.DESCRIPTION: Write true to skip the automatic schedule, false to resume it

MOWING.NAME: Mowing
MOWING.DESCRIPTION: Write true to mow for the default duration, false to park until the next scheduled task

MOW_MINUTES.NAME: Mow for [min]
MOW_MINUTES.DESCRIPTION: Write minutes to mow that long, 0 to park

PARK.NAME: Park until further notice
PARK.DESCRIPTION: Write true to park and pause the schedule

RESUME_SCHEDULE.NAME: Resume schedule
RESUME_SCHEDULE.DESCRIPTION: Write true to return to automatic operation

ON.NAME: On
ON.DESCRIPTION: Write true to switch on (until switched off), false to switch off until the next scheduled task

ON_MINUTES.NAME: On for [min]
ON_MINUTES.DESCRIPTION: Write minutes to switch on that long, 0 to switch off
